connector.name: Eia Energy MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Browse and query the EIA API v2 - electricity, petroleum, natural gas, coal, forecasts via MCP.
connector.summary: Hosted at eia-energy.caseyjhand.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package eia-energy-mcp-server. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the cyanheads account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: EIA_API_KEY
env.description: Free API key from api.eia.gov. Required — all requests use this as the api_key query parameter.

env.name: EIA_DATASET_TTL_SECONDS
env.description: Sliding per-dataframe TTL in seconds, extended by every query that references the dataframe.

env.name: EIA_DATAFRAME_DROP_ENABLED
env.description: Set to 'true' to expose eia_dataframe_drop for manual canvas cleanup.

env.name: EIA_CANVAS_MAX_ROWS
env.description: Cumulative row ceiling for eia_query_route DataCanvas staging. Five requests at EIA's 5000-row-per-request ceiling.

env.name: EIA_FACET_VALUE_CAP
env.description: Facet values eia_describe_route returns per facet before truncating. Page past it with the tool's facet and values_offset inputs.

env.name: CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE
env.description: Set to 'duckdb' to enable DataCanvas spillover for large query result sets (Node.js only).

env.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
env.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').
